inputBoundary: Each isolated agent received only the same 12 raw English sentences and /tmp/agent-contract.json, generated by the current core contract command. Gold Sem, expected roles, atoms, groups, and scoring metadata were not supplied.

Anscombe.rejectionReason: used termType instead of the transport contract's type field

agreement: The two agents selected the same eight predicates, roles, values, kinds, and four abstentions, but one used an invalid transport spelling. This is adoption/transport evidence only; agent agreement cannot certify semantic correctness or grounding.
interpretation: The generated contract plus typed builder can eliminate many structural failures for compliant agents. The extraction interface still needs a machine-readable executable builder schema/example, and unresolved open-concept identity remains outside the builder's authority.
